messages.text:
Looks good - leave the report as is, but make two separate SVGs:

- SD(R)/mean(R) as is, but remove the ODD, only keep nODD versions
- Underneath: reference plots in [0,1][1,2][2,3] over the same width, showing where the SD(R)/mean(R) was drawn from

I’ll leave the report unchanged and create two standalone SVGs: the nODD-only width comparison, and three response-distribution panels for |η| ranges [0,1], [1,2], and [2,3] that show the underlying R values.

For the reference panels, I’ll plot R divided by its mean within each η band, so the three calorimeters’ relative widths are easy to compare. I’ll include the raw means and SDs, retain zeros and tails, and label the distinction between these broad bands and the curve’s 0.05-wide bins.

Both SVGs are rendered at the same width. The first preserves all three nODD curves and intervals exactly. The reference panels retain all 10,000 events, including zeros; their moments use the full data. All ten existing report files, including the PDF, are unchanged.

Both SVGs reproduce byte-for-byte on replay, and the input guard rejects a swapped detector sample. The independent check is reviewing the new reference-bin statistics and the unchanged-report guarantee.
The independent check found no issues. It verified all nine reference distributions and confirmed that the three nODD curves, their 180 interval paths, and every existing report file are preserved.
Both SVGs are ready, and the report is unchanged. They’re pushed to PR #145; I’m checking the final commit’s CI status.

The [nODD-only comparison]([redacted] keeps the original curves and intervals. The [reference distributions]([redacted] span the same width in three |η| bands: [0,1), [1,2), and [2,3]. Token-accounting CI has passed; project validation is still running.
The ROOT-free analysis job has passed too. The remaining CI job is running the broader detector checks; no failures have appeared.

The figure checks are complete: all ten original report files are byte-identical, and both SVGs are 1000 pixels wide. The reference panels show normalized response distributions, with the raw mean and SD listed beneath each panel.
CI has passed 29 checks in the remaining job. The SVGs are published in PR #145; only the repository validation result is still pending.
The reference panels use the same matched 10k events. Their pooled SD/mean values are labelled separately from the fine η-bin curve points, so the two binning choices are explicit.
The remaining job has reached the slower tracker integration checks. The figure and analysis checks are complete, with no changes needed.
I also checked the PR discussion: there are no new review comments or open inline threads. PR #145 is mergeable, with the final CI job still running.
The reference distributions use R/mean(R) on the horizontal axis. This preserves SD(R)/mean(R) and makes the three response shapes easier to compare.
The tracker integration checks have passed. CI is now working through the final project and documentation checks.
All detector-control checks are green. The remaining job is checking project records and documentation links.
The accompanying [README]([redacted] places the two SVGs one above the other and includes the plotting recipe and source-data hashes.
The final record and link checks are still running without failures. The SVGs, reproduction recipe, review, and token accounting are committed.
CI is taking longer in the project-record tests. No step has failed, and the figures are ready to use.
The project-record and documentation-link checks have passed. CI is on its final software-preflight step.

Report unchanged. Created two equal-width SVGs:

- [SD(R)/mean(R), nODD versions only]([redacted]
- [Reference distributions in |η| bands [0,1), [1,2), [2,3]]([redacted]

They’re stacked in the accompanying README. [PR #145](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/145) includes the figures and token accounting; all CI checks pass.
